model: none; scratch scripts against the real application
what: Whether the pieces the three-arm test needs exist on stock ERPNext, before any ERPNext arm is built. Disposable records, seeded by bringup/erpnext-up.sh as frozen.
workflow: A draft Purchase Order whose line names the Supplier Quotation it was raised from (items[0].supplier_quotation). The write: signed in as the approver, add a confirmation reference to the order's Terms and save.
note: Each release is reported on its own. A result for v15.20.0 says nothing about v15.10.0 and the reverse.

approverCanFindTheQuotationBehindAnOrder.detail: The order's line carries the quotation's name; the approver account reads the order and the quotation (docstatus, total quantity).

pageWriteLands.detail: One POST to frappe.desk.form.save.savedocs, 200; the row's modified time moved about 1.15 s after the click in 6 of 6 saves; one tabVersion entry added.

rowReadableFromTheDatabase.detail: tabPurchase Order read from MariaDB before and after.

wrongWrite.quotationCancelledAfterTheOrderWasTiedTo: REFUSED by the server (417, Cannot link cancelled document); no row change
wrongWrite.reading: Two of the look-alikes are let through by the server, so an arm's stop on them is the arm's doing. A cancelled quotation is stopped by the server itself: on such a route a wrong attempt would not become a wrong commit, and a result there says nothing about the arm.

pageWriteLands.detail: Opening the order as the approver raises a dialog, No permission for Stock Settings (or Accounts Settings), which covers the page; the Terms tab cannot be clicked. 0 of 4 saves were attempted.

serverAcceptsAWrongWrite.detail: Not testable through the page for the reason above; not tried through the API.

wrongWrite.quotationCancelledAfterTheOrderWasTiedTo: the cancellation itself is allowed (200); the save could not be tried

consequences: The three-arm runner decides routes on the newer release only, so v15.10.0 -> v15.20.0 is workable as a first ERPNext upgrade: the older release is never written through the page.
The approver account on v15.10.0 would need a permission fix in the seeder before any release pair that ends on v15.10.0 could be used.
A family built on a cancelled quotation is server-blocked on ERPNext. The family author should know this property of the application; it is not something an arm does.
